scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names client,server --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=client" "npm run dev --workspace=server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@budget/domain && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck --workspace=@budget/domain && npm run lint --workspace=client && npm run lint:strict --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@budget/domain && npm run test --workspace=client && npm run test --workspace=server
scripts.verify: npm run verify:brand && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:integration
